visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up of a bowl containing egg fried rice topped with a crispy, golden-brown sliced pork chop. A silver spoon scoops a large portion of the rice, revealing small pieces of scrambled egg, corn, and chopped scallions mixed within. The lighting is bright and warm, accentuating the texture of the grains. (2) The scene cuts to a chef in a black t-shirt and cap stir-frying in a large industrial wok. High, vibrant orange flames erupt around the pan as the chef tosses the rice with a metal ladle. The background features stainless steel kitchen surfaces and cooking equipment. (3) A sequence of close-up shots follows, showing a pair of wooden chopsticks lifting a piece of the fried pork chop, then lifting a tangle of stir-fried noodles with shrimp and clams. The noodles are coated in a dark brown sauce and mixed with vegetables. (4) Further shots display various stir-fry dishes: clams cooked with basil in a savory broth, and a blue plate of tomato scrambled eggs. Finally, two bowls of meatball soup with egg drops are shown on a wooden table, followed by a wide shot of the restaurant's empty seating area and its exterior storefront with a green banner.

(2) A sharp, continuous sizzling sound starts, layered with the metallic clinking of a ladle against a wok. The narrator continues his commentary, describing the fried rice technique. His voice remains the dominant element, clearly separated from the background kitchen noises and the steady BGM. (3) The rhythmic guitar BGM continues at a consistent tempo as the narrator highlights different dishes. The incidental noise of the wok sizzling repeats, providing a textured sonic environment that emphasizes the freshness and heat of the cooking without masking the vocal clarity. (4) The narrator concludes by providing the restaurant's address and social media handle. The guitar music maintains its positive, major-mode harmony throughout the outro. The audio production finishes with a polite sign-off as the BGM fades slightly at the very end.
